name: Buffer Capacity
description: Increases buffer overflow granted upon merging Bytes by 5 per level.

name: Genetic Memory
description: Increases inherited base stats of newly merged Bytes by 1 per level.

name: Evolution Efficiency
description: Reduces the Energy cost of merging Bytes by 15 per level.

name: Dojo Veteran
description: Increases Bits earned from Combat Simulations by 5% per level.

name: Genetic Dominance
description: Increases inherited base stats of newly merged Bytes by an additional 1 per level.

name: Hunting Endurance
description: Unlocks higher consecutive battle queues in the Hunting Gauntlet (up to 100 rounds).

name: Teraflop Reclamation
description: Restores 5% of maximum Teraflops between hunting rounds per rank.
